title: One Step of the Input Rewind
statement: Let $S$ and $V$ be deterministic Turing machines over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary word, and let $j<|x|$. For either choice bit, one step of the reverse host from its loader configuration in state $1$, with input head at position $j+1$, assembly buffer containing $x$, and assembly head at position $|x|$, gives the loader configuration with input head at position $j$ and all other configuration data unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $S,V$ are finite deterministic machines over the binary alphabet
replaced: Let $S, V$ be deterministic machines and $x$ an input with $j < |x|$. For any choice bit, one host step from the rewind-state loader configuration with input head at position $j+1$ and assembly buffer $x$ moves the input head to position $j$, leaving all tapes unchanged.
